caption: The drawing depicts a decorative object composed primarily of geometric and ornamental shapes. The central structure resembles a frame or arch with a pediment at the top, decorated with alternating strips of red, yellow, and green, bordered in black. The arch is supported by two side elements, each adorned with feather-like shapes in red, green, and grey, as well as circular floral motifs at their bases. A shield-shaped form with a blue interior, accented by red, green, and white vertical stripes, is positioned in the lower left corner, overlapping the structure. The composition uses muted pastel hues including reds, greens, yellows, blues, whites, and grays, with darker outlines giving definition to the individual shapes. The background is off-white and unadorned, focusing attention on the central ornate object.
title: Reading Stand
